title: An `element.tolerance` of `0.25` written past the digit limit
why: The maximum is legal, and staying legal must not depend on how many zeroes follow it. This is the accepting half of the exact-decimal range rule: the refusing sibling (`0.25000000000000000001`) is satisfied by *any* engine that treats a long token as over the ceiling, so it alone would ratify one that refuses the ceiling itself.
